parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic. It is a long, narrow component attached to the frame body.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the eyeglasses on the user's ear and helps maintain stability when worn.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of plastic. It mirrors the left leg in shape and function.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the user's head, ensuring the eyeglasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge joint to fold inward or outward for storage or wearing.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lenses)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame body of the eyeglasses, which holds the lenses and connects to both legs. It is made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the lenses and provides the structural integrity of the eyeglasses, ensuring proper alignment with the user's eyes.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the central connecting structure for the two legs.
